# iqupt

> own course

HAXcms is a file-based CMS: authored pages and metadata are stored as portable files, not locked into a database-only workflow.
The canonical site structure is `site.json`, represented in JSON Outline Schema (`id`, `parent`, `order`, `slug`, `location`, and `metadata`).
Use HAX CLI and ecosystem tooling to maintain human-authored content while keeping machine-readable outputs synchronized.
Managed files (feeds, search indexes, manifests, and this `llms.txt`) are generated artifacts and should be rebuilt by tooling.

## Core resources
- [site.json](https://localhost:3000/sites/iqupt/site.json): Canonical site manifest and navigation tree in JSON Outline Schema format.
- [llms.txt](https://localhost:3000/sites/iqupt/llms.txt): LLM-oriented guide to this site and its machine-readable resources.

## Pages
- [Welcome to iqupt](https://localhost:3000/sites/iqupt/pages/item-ebaafb20-e0ff-4c42-91e0-05e3229fc70d/index.md): A playful corner of the wed to learn this tool using content from more sources Disrupting Ineffective Structures When existing systems fail the people who depend on them, the most effective response

## Optional
- [Search index](https://localhost:3000/sites/iqupt/lunrSearchIndex.json): Lunr corpus for quick full-text retrieval.
- [RSS feed](https://localhost:3000/sites/iqupt/rss.xml): Site updates in RSS format.
- [Atom feed](https://localhost:3000/sites/iqupt/atom.xml): Site updates in Atom format.
- [Sitemap](https://localhost:3000/sites/iqupt/sitemap.xml): URL-level discovery map for the published site.
